source: GLASS Encycled/QITT original owner research; standard IANA/NOAA/time system calculators
profile: GLASS CLOCK / UNISON; one symbol is a typed operation

operators.name: DEVICE CLOCK
operators.description: Client-reported wall-clock reading; if unavailable, UNKNOWN.

operators.name: UTC ORIGIN
operators.description: A sampled server UTC instant; POSIX timestamp ignores leap-second labels.

operators.name: SERVER CLOCK
operators.description: Server wall time sampled near this response; clock synchronization not assumed.

operators.name: MONOTONIC CLOCK
operators.description: Elapsed time since GLASS Python process start; arbitrary epoch, never civil time.

operators.name: NON-TIME
operators.description: An explicitly unobserved interval or unavailable clock value, not mathematical zero.

operators.name: CIVIL ZONE ROTOR
operators.description: IANA political zone rules including DST and historical changes; not derived from longitude.

operators.name: EARTH COORDINATE
operators.description: Latitude/longitude point, unit-sphere vector and its 15° geometric wedge.

operators.name: SOLAR TIME
operators.description: Mean solar time from longitude plus NOAA approximate equation of time and elevation.

operators.name: OFFSET DIFFERENCE
operators.description: Difference between legal UTC offsets of two IANA zones at one instant.

operators.name: CYCLE PHASE
operators.description: Phase 2π·((monotonic elapsed mod period)/period); logical periodic observable.

operators.name: SHELL GENERATOR
operators.description: Compiles the following admitted clock operator into a safe teaching shell script; never runs it.

operators.name: FRAME BEGIN
operators.description: Explicit group boundary; does not change clock values.

clock_domains.۞: browser client reported wall UTC millisecond epoch
clock_domains.◷: Python process monotonic time since startup

research_boundary: No device clock takeover, exact physical solar ephemeris, geographical legal-zone reverse lookup or shell execution claimed
